productFit.name: Gitzo Series 1 Traveler Carbon Fiber Tripod with Center Ball Head (GK1545T)

productFit.metricSpecs: Gitzo global: 1,45 kg, 163,5 cm max, 140,5 cm column down, 32,4 cm min, 42,5 cm closed, 10 kg safety payload (UNI/PdR 105:2021), -30 °C min working temperature, legs 25,3/21,7/18,2/14,7 mm, leg angles 25° and 70°
productFit.reason: Gitzo's global site lists the EU code with the same figures as the US page; no friction control on the head, as in the English post.

productFit.name: Peak Design Travel Tripod (Carbon Fiber)

localFacts.fact: Iberia permite un equipaje de mano de hasta 10 kg y 56 x 40 x 25 cm; Gitzo (42,5 cm), Peak Design (39,4 cm), K&F (39,5 cm) y Benro (51 cm) caben a lo largo, el Manfrotto 055 (72,5 cm) no.
Finnair, the usual carrier to Lapland via Helsinki, allows a carry-on bag of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm.
AEMET clasifica la fuerza 6 de Beaufort como "fresco", de 39 a 49 km/h.
El Mundo (11 May 2024): an aurora was visible in the skies of a large part of Spain, at least from Andalucía to Cataluña, Aragón and Galicia.
Términos: rótula de bola, zapata / placa de liberación rápida, columna central, bloqueo de rosca, cierre de palanca; Arca-Swiss igual en todas partes.

localPainPoints.pain: A worn or plastic tripod part snaps in the Arctic cold on arrival.
localPainPoints.fix: Carbon with metal locks for deep cold (Gitzo, Benro), check the tripod before the trip, and the Nat Hab plastic warning from the English post.

quotes.text: intentar alargar las patas del trípode y se me partió una de las sujeciones debido seguramente a su desgaste y al frío que hacía.

localPainPoints.pain: Gusts on the coast shake light tripods.
localPainPoints.fix: Column down, thin sections collapsed, legs wide, bag on the hook; Manfrotto 055 for windy self-drive trips.

Además insisto en lo del viento, ese trípode aguantaría mejor las inclemencias del tiempo.

localGain.point: Iberia and Finnair cabin sizes checked against each tripod's folded length.
